topic: Talking about the progress report calmly
caption:
Report came home? Stay calm and start with curiosity. 📋

Older kids can feel judged by a report before you say a word.
A few simple swaps help them open up and help you make one small plan.

What's the first thing you say when the report comes home?

#ParentingTips #ProgressReport #MiddleSchool #CanadianParents #OntarioEducation

slides.title: Read it first, then together
items: Read it on your own first
Find one thing that is going well.
A snack at the table beats the front door.
slides.example: Example: Omar's report says his writing is improving. Start right there.

slides.title: Make one small plan
items: One clear goal beats a long list.
A game, some reading or a little practice?
slides.example: Example: Leo picks a little fractions practice after dinner.
slides.note: Ask the teacher what helps most at home.
